description: HotLime Case Study 5: Po Basin Late Triassic-Middle Eocene carbonate geothermal reservoir is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.geus.dk. Results of mapping and assessment of the hydrotermal play in the Late Triassic-Middle Eocene carbonate succession beneath the Cenozoic p.p. siliciclastic infilling of the Po Basin (HotLime Case Study 5). Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Valutazione geotermica di base, Geothermal base assessment, Emilia-Romagna, Lombardia, Piemonte, GeoERA - GeoEnergy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
